Assembled crostini should be eaten within several hours. notes from the test kitchen shopping for honey Traditional honey is usually heated and strained to removed pollen and give the honey a clear appearance. Raw honey is treated more gently and retains most of its pollen. We prefer raw honey for its complexity and balanced sweetness.
